messages:
incident-bot: Paging Claire Chen (oncall) — High error rate detected in embeddings-api (us-west-2). Severity: P1. First detected 2026-03-15 09:12 UTC. Observed: ~30% 5xx over 5m, queue growth, increased latency. Use `/incident acknowledge` to claim.

Claire Chen: acked. I'm on it. Quick checks: node health, gpu OOM spikes, rollout status. @Dan Lewis can you confirm which pool is spiking?

Dan Lewis: seeing repeated GPU OOMs and retries from runtime on pool-emb-01 (node-gpu-7, node-gpu-9). Starting a rolling restart of the DS: `kubectl rollout restart ds/pool-emb-01 -n inference` — kicking off now. I'll tail logs: `kubectl logs -l app=pool-emb-01 -n inference --tail=200 -f`. ETA ~8-12m to stabilize.

Bob Jenkins: support here — customers are popping into Intercom with failed chat completions. Can someone drop two quick templates: (1) Intercom short ack, (2) Zendesk macro for ticket triage. Also need a statuspage blurb we can paste.

Emma R: drafting statuspage snippet below — please tweak if needed.

Emma R (status page snippet):
```
Component: Embeddings API — US-West (hosted)
Status: Degraded performance
Impact: Some requests for embeddings may fail or timeout; chat features relying on embeddings may return errors or degraded responses.
Update 09:15 UTC: Investigating increased 5xx errors. On-call working on mitigation (service restart in progress). No evidence of data loss. Next update: 09:35 UTC or sooner.
```

Claire Chen: looks good. Bob — Zendesk & Intercom templates below. Save as macros `embeddings-usw2-ack` and `embeddings-usw2-zd`.

Zendesk macro (copy into support macros):
```
Macro name: embeddings-usw2-zd
Subject: We're investigating an issue affecting embeddings in US-West
Comment (public reply):
Hi {{ticket.requester.name}},

Thanks for reporting this. We are investigating an incident affecting embeddings in the US-West region — some requests may return errors or time out. Our engineering team is working on mitigations and we've started a rolling restart of the embeddings pool. We expect another update by ~09:35 UTC.

If you can, please reply with a sample request ID or snippet. That will help us correlate logs.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll follow up as soon as we have more info.

— Redwood Support
```

Intercom quick reply (short):
```
Hi — thanks for flagging this. We’re aware of elevated errors for embeddings in US-West and are actively investigating. Engineers are mitigating now; expected update in ~20 minutes. We’ll follow up in this chat with any change. — Redwood Support
```

Claire Chen: agent troubleshooting checklist (share with Tier 1):
1) Check status page: https://status.redwood.example (or internal status tool).
2) Ask for a request ID or attach logs/snippet.
3) If customer needs immediate workaround, suggest: switch region to `eu-west-1` or reduce batch size/sequence length. Example SDK tip: `client = RedwoodClient(region="eu-west-1")`.
4) If customer is enterprise on Dedicated/Private, escalate to account team and include tenant id.
5) Use macro `embeddings-usw2-zd` for tickets and Intercom quick reply for chats.

Dan Lewis: restart completed on 3/5 of nodes at 09:22; rolling continues. Error rate falling from 30% -> ~6% (5m window) but still above baseline. Watching tail of `runtime/attn-errors` and `gpu-oom` metrics. If error rate not <1% after full rollout, plan B is to scale down batch sizes in runtime config and roll out a quantized model variant.

Bob Jenkins: copied macros into Intercom and Zendesk and created ticket macro `embeddings-usw2-ack` that adds internal tag `incident:emb-usw2`. Also created a public reply snippet for status updates.

Katie S: I'm stepping in for next 2h (Claire heading to a meeting). Handoff notes: restart in progress, partial recovery seen, watch 5xx rate and request queue length. If queue length > 500 for 3m, escalate to Dan and Claire immediately.

Claire Chen: handing off. Handoff template for oncall -> oncall: please include: what you did, what you saw, current mitigations, next steps, SLAs at risk. e.g.,
```
Handoff from Claire Chen to Katie S @ 2026-03-15 09:26 UTC
- Actions taken: rolled restart pool-emb-01 sequentially
- Observed: 5xx down from 30% -> 6%, queue length from 1200 -> 420
- Mitigations in flight: continue rollout, monitor logs, prepare model-quantized fallback
- Next update ETA: 09:35 UTC
```

Katie S: acked, taking over. I'll watch logs and post updates every 10m or on status changes. Bob — please keep the support queue updated with the status page link and the macro applied.

support-bot: macro `embeddings-usw2-zd` saved by Bob Jenkins.

Dan Lewis: note for later — create an alert runbook entry for GPU OOM pattern on embeddings pool (tag: runbook/gpu-oom) and a postmortem checklist item to evaluate memory usage per shard.

Bob Jenkins: thanks — I'll push a follow-up to all open tickets with the updated ETA once Claire/Katie confirm 09:35 update.

Claire Chen: leaving a final quick checklist for whoever inherits: 1) confirm 5xx < 1% for 15m, 2) check tail latency under 95th perc baseline, 3) confirm no regression in quality after model fallback (if used). If all clear, prepare status page "service restored" update and close incident channel.

Katie S: will do. Posting next update at 09:35 UTC or sooner. :white_check_mark:
